name: Spanish Common Words Set 43
description: This set is part of a larger collection of common Spanish words frequently used in everyday language.

cards.sentence: Mi amigo siempre me ayuda con mis tareas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My friend always helps me with my homework.

cards.sentence: Me gusta correr por el parque por la mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to run in the park in the morning.

cards.sentence: El paisaje es hermoso en primavera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The landscape is beautiful in spring.

cards.sentence: Voy a trabajar todos los días de la semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to work every day of the week.

cards.sentence: Ella siempre está feliz cuando está con su familia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She is always happy when she is with her family.

cards.sentence: El tiempo pasa rápido cuando te diviertes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Time flies when you are having fun.

cards.sentence: El perro es muy grande y amigable.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The dog is very big and friendly.

cards.sentence: Quiero saber más sobre la historia de España.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to know more about the history of Spain.

cards.sentence: La casa de mis abuelos es muy antigua.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My grandparents' house is very old.

cards.sentence: Nos gusta comer pizza los viernes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We like to eat pizza on Fridays.

cards.sentence: Estoy bien, gracias por preguntar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am fine, thank you for asking.

cards.sentence: Mi familia es muy unida y siempre se apoya.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My family is very close and always supports each other.

cards.sentence: Me gusta leer libros por la noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to read books at night.

cards.sentence: Mi coche nuevo es muy rápido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My new car is very fast.

cards.sentence: El cielo está despejado y azul.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sky is clear and blue.

cards.sentence: Los niños quieren jugar en el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The kids want to play in the park.

cards.sentence: Quiero ver esa película este fin de semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to see that movie this weekend.

cards.sentence: La luz del sol es muy brillante hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sunlight is very bright today.

cards.sentence: La felicidad no depende de las cosas materiales.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Happiness does not depend on material things.

cards.sentence: El cuerpo humano tiene muchas funciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The human body has many functions.

cards.sentence: La música me hace sentir bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Music makes me feel good.

cards.sentence: Me gusta caminar por la playa al atardecer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to walk on the beach at sunset.

cards.sentence: El paisaje de esta zona es impresionante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The landscape in this area is stunning.

cards.sentence: Voy a viajar a México el próximo verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to travel to Mexico next summer.

cards.sentence: Tengo un perro que es muy juguetón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have a dog that is very playful.

cards.sentence: El coche que compré es de color rojo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The car I bought is red.

cards.sentence: Me gustaría conocer a tus amigos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I would like to meet your friends.

cards.sentence: La roca es muy pesada.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The rock is very heavy.

cards.sentence: Voy a la librería a comprar un libro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to the bookstore to buy a book.

cards.sentence: El mar es de un hermoso color azul.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sea is a beautiful blue color.

cards.sentence: El mar puede ser muy tranquilo o muy agitado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sea can be very calm or very rough.

cards.sentence: Quiero saber cómo se hace esto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to know how to do this.

cards.sentence: La silla está rota y no puedo usarla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The chair is broken and I can't use it.

cards.sentence: Voy a pintar mi habitación de azul.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to paint my room blue.

cards.sentence: El jardín tiene muchas flores hermosas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The garden has many beautiful flowers.

cards.sentence: España es un país con mucha historia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Spain is a country with a lot of history.

cards.sentence: Voy a volver a casa mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I will return home tomorrow.

cards.sentence: Me gusta correr por la mañanas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to run in the mornings.

cards.sentence: Este es un mal ejemplo de comportamiento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This is a bad example of behavior.

cards.sentence: Eso es una buena noticia para todos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That is good news for everyone.

cards.sentence: Cada persona es única y especial.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Every person is unique and special.

cards.sentence: Me encanta cocinar para mis amigos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love to cook for my friends.

cards.sentence: Necesito guardar esto en un lugar seguro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to keep this in a safe place.

cards.sentence: Hace mucho calor en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is very hot in summer.

cards.sentence: Voy a esperar a que llegues.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I will wait for you to arrive.

cards.sentence: Espero poder ayudar a los demás.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope to be able to help others.

cards.sentence: Prefiero mi café sin azúcar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer my coffee without sugar.

cards.sentence: El verano es mi estación favorita.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Summer is my favorite season.

cards.sentence: Me gusta escribir en mi diario todos los días.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to write in my journal every day.

cards.sentence: El cerebro es un órgano muy complejo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The brain is a very complex organ.

cards.sentence: Me gusta andar en bicicleta en el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to ride my bike in the park.

cards.sentence: La planta empieza a brotar después de la lluvia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The plant starts to sprout after the rain.

cards.sentence: La felicidad se encuentra en las pequeñas cosas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Happiness is found in the little things.

cards.sentence: El tiempo cambia rápidamente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The weather changes quickly.

cards.sentence: El hombre está leyendo un libro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The man is reading a book.

cards.sentence: Me miro al espejo cada mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I look in the mirror every morning.

cards.sentence: La mesa está decorada para la cena.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The table is set for dinner.

cards.sentence: La tierra es el hogar de millones de especies.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The earth is home to millions of species.

cards.sentence: Es importante ser honesto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is important to be honest.

cards.sentence: Mi coche es rojo y rápido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My car is red and fast.

cards.sentence: La salud es lo más importante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Health is the most important.

cards.sentence: El chico juega con su pelota en el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The boy plays with his ball in the park.

cards.sentence: La nieve cubre todo el paisaje en invierno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The snow covers the whole landscape in winter.

cards.sentence: Hay muchas cosas que aprender en la vida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are many things to learn in life.

cards.sentence: Voy a la universidad para estudiar medicina.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to university to study medicine.

cards.sentence: El río es muy largo y profundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The river is very long and deep.

cards.sentence: El viento sopla fuerte esta tarde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The wind is blowing strong this afternoon.

cards.sentence: El perro es un animal amigable.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The dog is a friendly animal.

cards.sentence: Me gusta bailar en las fiestas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to dance at parties.

cards.sentence: Siempre almuerzo a la una de la tarde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I always have lunch at one in the afternoon.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos medir la dureza de esta roca.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need to measure the hardness of this rock.

cards.sentence: Dibuja una línea recta en el papel.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Draw a straight line on the paper.

cards.sentence: Me encanta comer fruta fresca en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love to eat fresh fruit in the summer.

cards.sentence: La flor en el jardín huele muy bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The flower in the garden smells very good.

cards.sentence: Bebe una taza de té caliente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Drink a cup of hot tea.

cards.sentence: Este es un buen ejemplo de comportamiento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This is a good example of behavior.

cards.sentence: El rey gobierna con justicia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The king rules with justice.

cards.sentence: Me gusta el vino tinto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like red wine.

cards.sentence: Voy a cambiar de trabajo el próximo mes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to change jobs next month.

cards.sentence: La paz es fundamental en nuestras vidas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Peace is fundamental in our lives.

cards.sentence: Las flores son hermosas en primavera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The flowers are beautiful in spring.

cards.sentence: Subí la escalera para llegar al ático.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I climbed the ladder to reach the attic.

cards.sentence: Me gusta cocinar en la cocina de mi casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to cook in my kitchen at home.

cards.sentence: Los días son más largos en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Days are longer in summer.
